name: building-blocks-selection-controls
title: Selection Controls
description: Small Tailwind selection atoms for checks, radios, switches, choice chips, and row-level selection affordances.
useWhen: Small Tailwind selection atoms for checks, radios, switches, choice chips, and row-level selection affordances.
avoidWhen: Avoid selection controls when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Selection Controls uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
